text:
maria: Starting ap-south3 cloud account + VNet onramp. Objective: create host (shared) VPC + one service project for GPU workloads, request GPU quotas (A100/A10), reserve CIDR, and hand off to netops for peering. I can own coord and PRs.

kai: @maria SGTM. We should do Shared VPC host project to centralize egress + logging. Will prepare terraform modules for shared-vpc host + service attachment. Do we want single /20 per service or /21?

maria: prefer /20 per service for now to keep room for subnets. Reserve 10.60.0.0/20 for this service project. Make sure it does not overlap with corp VPN ranges (attach org CIDR map).

devin: FYI ap-south3 has limited A100 capacity. I'll open a quota + capacity request. If A100 can't be provisioned, fallback plan is A10 or A2 depending on perf needs. Ticket: PROD-2028.

ashley: Cost note: if we route egress through centralized Cloud NAT we can get better observability but watch NAT egress IP costs. If expected egress > 5TB/mo, consider egress proxy + compression. I'll draft a cost delta after dev hours estimate.

samir: Quick smoke checklist I want in the runbook:
1) apply terraform host + service (dry-run)
2) verify shared VPC host project binding and IAM: compute.networkUser for node service accounts
3) create single GKE GPU nodepool (1 node, 1 GPU) with taints and check Node Ready
4) deploy gpu-shell image and run nvidia-smi + small inference test (latency < 100ms)
5) verify NAT egress IPs and firewall (bastion SSH, prometheus 9090, app 443)
6) confirm logs flow to central logging sink

kai: Terraform snippet I'll paste in the PR (replace placeholders):
```
resource "google_compute_network" "shared_vpc" {
  name                    = "rw-shared-vpc-ap-south3"
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
}
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "svc_subnet" {
  name          = "svc-subnet-1"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.60.0.0/20"
  region        = "ap-south3"
  network       = google_compute_network.shared_vpc.id
}
resource "google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project" "host" {
  project = var.host_project_id
}
```

maria: Good. Add firewall rule for internal ephemeral ports (1024-65535) and a rule for prometheus scraping from central monitoring. Also add tags for GPU nodes.

devin: Quota request payload for console: region=ap-south3, SKU=A100, needed=8 GPUs, priority=high. Support ETA ~48-96h. If we get rejection, we escalate with sales if customer-backed.

ashley: Cost back-of-envelope: baseline dev cluster (4 A100 hrs/day on-demand) ~ 4 * 24 * 30 * $4 = ~$11.5k/mo; spot reduces to ~ $3.5k/mo. NAT egress: 2TB/mo ~ $100; 10TB ~ $500. I'll refine once dev hours are in.

netops-bot: (netops-bot) Onramp checklist generated:
- Reserve org CIDR 10.60.0.0/20
- Create host project: rw-shared-host-ap-south3
- Create service project: rw-gpu-prod-ap-south3
- Enable APIs: compute, container, cloudresourcemanager, servicenetworking
- Submit GPU quota request (PROD-2028)
- Configure Shared VPC attachment + IAM roles
- Provision Cloud NAT with 2 ephemeral IPs for HA
- Schedule peering with central hub if required

maria: Assigning owners: @kai terraform + PR, @devin quota + escalation, @ashley cost + signoff, @samir smoke runbook + validation. I'll schedule 30m handoff tomorrow 10:30 IST and link infra PR here. After smoke pass, netops can start peering and we cut service accounts.

devin: Ticket updated PROD-2028: requested 8 A100 GPUs, alt SKU A10/A2 noted. Support replied asking for expected sustained usage numbers. Pinging @maria for numbers.

maria: Replying in ticket: expected sustained 200 GPU-hours/day initially, spike to 800 GPU-hours/day in peak testing. Please include this in request.

samir: Post-smoke validation steps I will run and push results to the PR: node gpu detection, container inference loop (1000 requests), latency histogram, logs -> central sink, egress IP validation.

maria: Thanks team. I'll drop the PR link here once ready. :rocket:
